info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API allows users to retrieve a list of parking reservations that have been checked out. This endpoint facilitates the management of parking utilization by providing insights into current and past checkouts. Typical consumers include parking management systems and service providers looking to optimize space and streamline operations. Developers can use this API to enhance reporting capabilities and improve user experiences by integrating checkout data into their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the checkout details for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the necessary details for checking out their reservations, including payment options and confirmation requirements.
